worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.summary: The user wields its whole body like a hammer, swinging it down along a vertical arc onto a single target: the first real body or terrain it meets decides the landing, and on impact the target is hurled along the contact direction and left staggering, barely able to move (it can still attack). Heavy swings harder, staggers longer and knocks foes less far; Swift winds up faster, swings faster and knocks foes farther.
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.use.0: Stagger a charging target and cut its movement
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.use.1: Land one heavy Dragon-type contact hit on a single target
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.use.2: Break a foe's chase rhythm at close quarters
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.use.3: Hurl a target away to make room for allies
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.descripti: The whole body is swung down along a vertical arc for about %1$s Dragon-type contact damage to the first target actually met, at a reach of about %2$s blocks; a wall stops the swing at its surface and nothing behind it is hit. The foe's Defence, type matchups and critical hits are settled on impact.

On a hit the target is hurled about %1$s blocks along the actual contact direction and left staggering for about %2$s seconds: its ground and flying movement speed drop by 85%%, so it can only shuffle along — though it can still attack.
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.heavy.on: Heavy on: about ×1.15 power, ×1.3 stagger and ×0.8 knockback, +3 ticks wind-up, +8 ticks cooldown and +1 tick on the arc — a heavier swing that leaves the target slower longer.
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.heavy.off: Heavy off (Swift): about ×1.25 knockback, ×1.1 reach, a faster prepare and −1 tick on the arc, at about ×0.9 power and a shorter stagger.
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.timing: Cast at a target within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s-second prepare it spends %4$s PP, then recovers %3$s seconds; cooldown %5$s seconds from commit.
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.growth.0: At level %1$s, hammer power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.preferenc: On: about ×1.15 power, ×1.3 stagger and ×0.8 knockback, +3 ticks wind-up, +8 ticks cooldown and +1 tick on the arc — a heavier swing that leaves the target slower longer. Off (Swift): about ×1.25 knockback, ×1.1 reach, a faster wind-up and −1 tick on the arc, at about ×0.9 power and a shorter stagger.
The companion only swings while a target is within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
Not already staggered skips foes still slowed by a stagger, saving the swing for a target that is still standing; the default Anytime still hits a staggered foe for the main damage.
